ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be online and synchronous. 4 hours Topic: Aeroacoustics. Physical mechanisms and mathematical modeling of sound generation and flow-sound interaction; An overview of aeroacoustics theories and computational approaches; Advanced turbulence simulation techniques (DNS, LES, unsteady RANS) for evaluation nonlinear sound sources; Accurate numerical methods and boundary conditions for direct computation of sound generation and propagation. Both engineering biological systems (e.g., the human voice) will be discussed. Prerequisites: Intermediate level courses in fluid mechanics and CFD (or numerical methods).
